import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { AnchoredController } from '../../controllers/anchored-controller.js';
export declare class ContextualHelp extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        title: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        content: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        variant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        placement: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        triggerLabel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        relatedId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        fallbackFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    content: string | TemplateResult;
    variant: string;
    placement: string;
    triggerLabel: string;
    relatedId: string;
    fallbackFocusId: string;
    private state;
    private fallbackBoundary?;
    private restoreRequested;
    private focusRequested;
    readonly anchor: AnchoredController;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    private show;
    private outside;
    private key;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    updated(): void;
    render(): TemplateResult<1>;
}
